aside.browse: Anyone can explore active requests — no account needed.
aside.save: An account lets you save requests and get status updates.
aside.privacy: Your email is never shown publicly or shared with requesters.

fields.name: Full name
fields.emailHelper: Used to sign in and for updates you choose. Never shown publicly.

errors.email: Enter a valid email, e.g. name@example.org
errors.passwordRules: Use a password that meets every requirement below.
errors.terms: You need to accept to create an account.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

requirements.label: Password requirements
requirements.number: At least one number or symbol

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to save requests and view coordination-desk contacts.
login.roleNote: Coordinators and administrators use this same sign-in. What you can do depends on the role assigned to your account.
login.incorrectBody: Check both and try again. After 5 failed attempts, sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Only what’s needed to save requests and get updates. No medical information is required.
register.terms: I agree to the Terms of use and Privacy notice (required)
register.updates: Email me when a request I saved changes (optional)

verify.title: Check your inbox
verify.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. It expires in 60 minutes. You can keep browsing requests in the meantime.
verify.wrongAddress: Wrong address? Create the account again — unverified accounts are deleted after 7 days.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with and we’ll send a reset link.
recovery.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, you’ll get a reset link within a few minutes. It works once and expires in 30 minutes.
recovery.privacyNote: For your privacy, we show this message whether or not the email is registered.
recovery.expiredTitle: This link has expired or was already used
recovery.expiredBody: Reset links work once and expire after 30 minutes. Request a new one to continue.
recovery.newSubtitle: You’ll be signed out on other devices after the change.
